title: Distance at signal reception
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the distance from car A to detector B when the ultrasonic signal is received, obtaining 340 m.

title: Total braking time
description: Essential: Correctly determines the total time from signal reception to full stop, obtaining 2 s.

title: Acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the magnitude of the car's acceleration during braking, obtaining 5 m/s².

title: Initial velocity
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the car's initial velocity at the start of braking, obtaining 10 m/s.

title: Signal travel reasoning
description: Important: Applies the correct relationship for the ultrasonic signal's round-trip travel time and distance to find the reception point.

title: Kinematics application
description: Important: Correctly uses kinematics equations (e.g., s = 1/2 a t², v = a t) for uniformly decelerated motion to link displacement, time, acceleration, and initial velocity.

title: Infrared signal assumption
description: Optional: Explicitly states or uses the assumption that the infrared signal travel time is negligible.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s²) throughout the calculation.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses acceleration with incorrect sign (positive for deceleration) or misinterprets the direction of motion.

title: Misinterpreting signal times
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly equates the ultrasonic signal's one-way travel time with the total braking time or misapplies the 3:1 distance ratio.
